definitions.attic: a space or room inside or partly inside the roof of a building.
definitions.chai: tea made by boiling tea leaves with milk, sugar, and sometimes spices.
definitions.chaotic: in a state of complete confusion and disorder.
definitions.chit: a short official note, memorandum, or voucher, typically recording a sum owed.
definitions.ciao: used as a greeting at meeting or parting.
definitions.cist: a coffin or burial chamber made from stone or a hollowed tree.
definitions.hiss: make a sharp sibilant sound as of the letter s, often as a sign of disapproval or derision.
definitions.hoist: raise by means of ropes and pulleys.
definitions.iota: the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet (Ι, ι), transliterated as ‘i’.
definitions.itch: an uncomfortable sensation or condition that causes a desire to scratch the skin.
definitions.oasis: a fertile spot in a desert where the water table rises to ground level.
definitions.schist: a coarse-grained metamorphic rock which consists of layers of different minerals and can be split into thin irregular plates.
definitions.stitch: a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.
definitions.stochastic: having a random probability distribution or pattern that can be analysed statistically but not predicted precisely.
definitions.tacit: understood or implied without being stated.
definitions.tactic: an action or strategy carefully planned to achieve a specific end.
definitions.this: used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand or being indicated or experienced.
